cards.abilities: Fight: Reveal the top seven cards of the Villain Deck. Mr. Sinister captures all of the Bystanders you revealed. Put the rest back in random order.

cards.name: Plans Within Plans
cards.abilities: Fight: Mr. Sinister captures a Bystander for each Mr. Sinister Tactic in players' Victory Piles, including this Tactic.

cards.name: Telepathic Manipulation
cards.abilities: Fight: Mr. Sinister captures a Bystander from each other player's Victory Pile.

cards.name: Stryfe
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: MLF
Master Strike: Stack this Master Strike next to Stryfe. Stryfe gets +1[Attack] for each Master Strike stacked next to him. Each player reveals a [X-Force] Hero or discards a card at random.

cards.name: Furious Wrath
cards.abilities: Fight: Reveal the top six cards of the Villain Deck. Play all the Master Strikes you revealed. Put the rest back in random order.

cards.name: Psychic Torment
cards.abilities: Fight: Look at the top five cards of your deck. Put one into your hand and discard the rest.

cards.name: Swift Vengeance
cards.abilities: Fight: A Wound from the Wound Stack becomes a Master Strike that takes effect immediately.

cards.name: Tide of Retribution
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals an [X-Force] Hero or gains a Wound.

cards.name: Evil Deadpool
cards.abilities:
[Revenge for Mastermind Tactics]
Always Leads: Evil Deadpool Corpse
Master Strike: Without talking, each player simultaneously discards a card. Whoever discards the lowest-costing card (or tied for lowest) gains a Wound.

cards.name: Evil Even Oddball
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals their hand. Whoever has the fewest cards with odd-numbered costs (or tied for fewest) gains a Wound.

cards.name: Hyper-Insane Healing Factor
cards.abilities: Fight: If this is not the final Tactic, you get +6[Recruit] and shuffle this Tactic back into the other Tactics.

cards.name: Of Course it's Corpse
cards.abilities: Fight: The other player with the fewest Evil Deadpool Corpse Villains in their Victory Pile (or tied for fewest) gains a Wound.

cards.name: Stitched from Dead (Pool) Parts
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player discards the top card of their deck. Whoever discards the lowest-costing card (or tied for lowest) gains a Wound.

cards.name: Macho Gomez
cards.abilities:
[Revenge for Deadpool's “Friends“]
Always Leads: Deadpool's “Friends“
Master Strike: Put this Strike in front of you as a “Bounty on Your Head.“ Then, each player gains a Wound for each Bounty on them. Any number of times during your turn, you may pay 1[Recruit] to move a Bounty from you to the player on your left.

cards.name: Bounty Payout
cards.abilities: Fight: You get +1[Recruit] for each “Bounty on Your Head“ on other players.

cards.name: Interstellar Assassin
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player with at least one “Bounty on Your Head“ discards down to 4 cards.

cards.name: Renegotiate the Contract
cards.abilities: Fight: Redistribute the “Bounty on Your Head“ cards among any number of players.

cards.name: Super Macho Man
cards.abilities: Fight: Rescue a Bystander for each “Bounty on Your Head“ on other players.

cards.name: J. Jonah Jameson
cards.abilities:
Start of Game: Put 2 S.H.I.E.L.D. Officers per player into a face down “Angry Mobs“ stack.
Special Rules: You can spend 4[Attack] to reveal a random Angry Mob and put it into any player's discard pile. You can't fight J. Jonah Jameson while he has Angry Mobs.
Always Leads: Spider-Slayers
Master Strike: Each player [Investigates] their deck for a card and puts it into the Angry Mobs stack.

cards.name: Epic J. Jonah Jameson
cards.abilities:
Start of Game: Put 3 S.H.I.E.L.D. Officers per player into a face down “Angry Mobs“ stack.
Special Rules: You can spend 5[Attack] to reveal a random Angry Mob and put it into any player's discard pile. You can't fight J. Jonah Jameson while he has Angry Mobs.
Always Leads: Spider-Slayers
Master Strike: Each player [Investigates] their deck for a card and puts it into the Angry Mobs stack. If that card cost 0, that player gains a Wound.

cards.name: Incite Violent Riots
cards.abilities: Fight: Each player puts a Wound from the Wound Stack into the Angry Mobs stack.

cards.name: Promote Spider-Slayer Security
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player puts a Spider-Slayer from their Victory Pile into the Angry Mobs stack. When a Spider-Slayer is revealed from the Angry Mobs, it enters the city.

cards.name: Slanderous Editorial
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player [Investigates] their deck for a non-grey Hero and puts it into the Angry Mobs stack. Players reveal all the cards they investigated.

cards.name: That Menace Spider-Man!
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and discard a [Spider Friends] Hero. Any player who cannot must instead put a non-grey card from their hand into the Angry Mobs stack.

cards.name: Nightmare
cards.abilities:
When you fight Nightmare in the [Astral Plane], instead of revealing a Tactic, KO one of your Heroes and Nightmare moves to the Mastermind Space.
Always Leads: Fear Lords
Master Strike: Nightmare enters the [Astral Plane]. If he was already there, each player discards a random card.
Escape: Each player KOs one of their non-grey Heroes. Nightmare moves to the Mastermind space.

cards.name: Epic Nightmare
cards.abilities:
When you fight Nightmare in the [Astral Plane], instead of revealing a Tactic, KO one of your Heroes and Nightmare moves to the Mastermind Space.
Always Leads: Fear Lords
Master Strike: Nightmare enters the [Astral Plane]. If he was already there, each player discards two random cards.
Escape: Each player KOs one of their non-grey Heroes. Nightmare moves to the Mastermind space.

cards.name: Don't Fall Asleep
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player discards two cards with [Recruit] icons. Nightmare enters the [Astral Plane].

cards.name: Dream Weaver
cards.abilities: Fight: For each of your [Ranged] Heroes, rescue a Bystander. Nightmare enters the [Astral Plane].

cards.name: Night Terrors
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals a [Covert] Hero or gains a Wound. Nightmare enters the [Astral Plane].

cards.name: Deadly Waking Nightmares
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player KOs one of their non-grey Heroes. Each player who KO'd a Hero this way draws a card. Nightmare enters the [Astral Plane].

cards.name: Dormammu
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Lords of the Netherworld
Master Strike: Each player makes a [Demonic Bargain] with Dormammu to discard down to four cards.

cards.name: Epic Dormammu
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Lords of the Netherworld
Master Strike: Each player reveals the top card of their deck and discards it if it costs 0. Then each player makes a [Demonic Bargain] with Dormammu to discard down to three cards.

cards.name: Demonic Hellfire
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player makes a [Demonic Bargain] with Dormammu to KO a non-grey Hero from their discard pile.

cards.name: Flames of Regency
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player makes a [Demonic Bargain] with Dormammu to discard a card with an [Attack] icon.

cards.name: Barter for Souls
cards.abilities: Fight: Choose a player to make a [Demonic Bargain] with Dormammu to gain a Hero from the HQ that costs 6 or less.

cards.name: Torments of the Dark Dimension
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player makes a [Demonic Bargain] with Dormammu to gain a 0-cost Hero from the KO pile.

cards.name: Uru-Enchanted Iron Man
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: The Mighty
Command Strike: [Demolish] each player. Then stack this Strike next to Iron Man. Uru-Enchanted Iron Man has an [Uru-Enchanted Weapon] for each Strike stacked here.

cards.name: Armor of the Destroyer
cards.abilities: Fight: For each [Tech] Ally you have, [demolish] each other player.

cards.name: Pepper Potts in Rescue Armor
cards.abilities: Fight: A Bystander from the Bystander Stack becomes a Command Strike that takes effect immediately.

cards.name: Quantum Inventions
cards.abilities: Fight: Draw two cards. Then, if you reveal a [Tech] card, draw two more cards.

cards.name: Repulsor Coils
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals a [Tech] Ally or gains a Bindings.

cards.name: Galactus
cards.abilities:
[Cosmic Threat]: [Strength][Instinct][Covert][Tech][Ranged]
Always Leads: Heralds of Galactus
Master Strike: Destroy the city space closest to Galactus. Any Villain there escapes. Put this Master Strike there.
Galactus Wins: When the city is destroyed.

cards.name: Cosmic Entity
cards.abilities: Fight: Choose [Strength], [Instinct], [Covert], [Tech] or [Ranged]. Each player reveals any number of cards of that class, then draws that many cards.

cards.name: Force of Eternity
cards.abilities: Fight: When you draw a new hand of cards at the end of this turn, draw six extra cards, then discard six cards.

cards.name: Panicked Mobs
cards.abilities: Fight: Choose [Strength], [Instinct], [Covert], [Tech] or [Ranged]. Each player reveals any number of cards of that class, then rescues that many Bystanders.

cards.name: Sunder the Earth
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player KOs all Heroes from their discard pile with the same card name as a Hero in the HQ.

cards.name: Mole Man
cards.abilities:
Mole Man gets +1[Attack] for each Subterranea Villain that has escaped.
Always Leads: Subterranea
Master Strike: All Subterranea Villains in the city escape. If any Villains escaped this way, each player gains a Wound.

cards.name: Dig to Freedom
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player chooses a Subterranea Villain in their Victory Pile and puts it into the Escaped Villains pile.

cards.name: Master of Monsters
cards.abilities: Fight: If this is not the final Tactic, reveal the top six cards of the Villain Deck. Play all the Subterranea Villains you revealed. Put the rest on the bottom of the Villain Deck in random order.

cards.name: Secret Tunnel
cards.abilities: Fight: You get +6[Attack] usable only against Villains in the Streets.

cards.name: Underground Riches
cards.abilities: Fight: You get +6[Recruit] usable only to recruit Heroes in the HQ space under the Streets.

cards.name: Supreme Intelligence of the Kree
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Kree Starforce
Master Strike: The Supreme Intelligence gains a [Shard]. Then each player reveals their hand and discards each with cost equal to, and cost one higher than, the number of Shards on the Supreme Intelligence.

cards.name: Combined Knowledge of All Kree
cards.abilities: Fight: The Supreme Intelligence gains a [Shard] for each Kree Villain in the city and/or the Escape Pile.

cards.name: Cosmic Omniscience
cards.abilities: Fight: The Supreme Intelligence gains a [Shard] for each Master Strike in the KO pile.

cards.name: Countermeasure Protocols
cards.abilities: Fight: The Supreme Intelligence gains a [Shard] for each Mastermind Tactic (including this one) in any player's Victory Pile.

cards.name: Guide Kree Evolution
cards.abilities: Fight: The Supreme Intelligence and Kree Villains in the city each gain a [Shard].

cards.name: Thanos
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Infinity Gems
Thanos gets -2[Attack] for each Infinity Gem Artifact card controlled by any player.
Master Strike: Each player reveals their hand and puts one of their non-grey Heroes next to Thanos in a “Bound Souls“ pile.

cards.name: Centuries of Envy
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player discards an Infinity Gem Artifact card they control.

cards.name: God of Death
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and gains a Wound for each card that player has with the same card name as any card in Thanos' Bound Souls pile.

cards.name: Keeper of Souls
cards.abilities: Fight: Gain a Hero from Thanos' Bound Souls pile. Then each other player puts a non-grey Hero from their discard pile into Thanos' Bound Souls pile.

cards.name: The Mad Titan
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and discards all cards with the same card name as any card in Thanos' Bound Souls pile.

cards.name: Hela, Goddess of Death
cards.abilities:
[Bridge Conqueror 5, Streets Conqueror 5]
Always Leads: Omens of Ragnarok
Master Strike: This Strike enters the city as a 5[Attack] “Army of the Dead“ Villain worth 3VP. Then choose a Villain worth 3VP or more from your Victory Pile (including an Army of the Dead) to enter the city. If you didn't have any, each player gains a Wound.

cards.name: Epic Hela, Goddess of Death
cards.abilities:
[Bridge Conqueror 6, Streets Conqueror 6, Rooftops Conqueror 6]
Always Leads: Omens of Ragnarok
Master Strike: This Strike enters the city as a 6[Attack] “Army of the Dead“ Villain worth 4VP. Then choose a Villain worth 4VP or more from your Victory Pile (including an Army of the Dead) to enter the city. If you didn't have any, each player gains a Wound.

cards.name: Hela's Cloak
cards.abilities:
Fight: Rescue 4 Bystanders. Hela captures this card as a [Villainous Weapon].
 | 
[Artifact] - Once during each player's turn, if you would gain a Wound, you may draw a card instead.

cards.name: The Nightsword
cards.abilities:
Fight: Rescue 4 Bystanders. Hela captures this card as a [Villainous Weapon].
 | 
[Thrown Artifact] - When you throw this, you get [Bridge Conqueror 3].

cards.name: Seize Bifrost, The Rainbow Bridge
cards.abilities: Fight: Reveal the top card of the Villain Deck. If it's a Villain, that Villain enters the Bridge or Streets, if one of those spaces is empty.

cards.name: Naglfar, Longship of Fingernails
cards.abilities: Fight: The player on your right reveals the Villain from their Victory Pile that's worth the most VP. That Villain enters the Bridge or Streets, if one of those spaces is empty.

cards.name: Malekith the Accursed
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Dark Council
Master Strike: Malekith captures a [Villainous Weapon] from the city or from any player's control or discard pile. Then this Master Strike enters the city as a [Villainous Weapon] called “Darkspear“ that gives +2[Attack]. When you gain a Darkspear, it becomes a [Thrown Artifact] that gives +2[Attack] when thrown.

cards.name: Epic Malekith the Accursed
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Dark Council
Master Strike: Malekith captures a [Villainous Weapon] from the city, then captures one from any player's control or discard pile. Then this Master Strike enters the city as a [Villainous Weapon] called “Darkspear“ that gives +3[Attack]. When you gain a Darkspear, it becomes a [Thrown Artifact] that gives +2[Attack] when thrown.

cards.name: Black Hammer of the Accursed
cards.abilities:
Fight: Rescue 4 Bystanders. Malekith captures a [Villainous Weapon] from the city or from any player's control or discard pile. The this Tactic enters the city as a [Villainous Weapon].
 | 
[Artifact] - Once per turn, you may KO a Hero from your discard pile.

cards.name: Dagger of Living Abyss
cards.abilities:
Fight: Rescue 4 Bystanders. Malekith captures a [Villainous Weapon] from the city or from any player's control or discard pile. The this Tactic enters the city as a [Villainous Weapon].
 | 
[Artifact] - Once per turn, you may defeat a Villain worth 2VP or less.

cards.name: The Hunting Horn of Faerie
cards.abilities:
Fight: Rescue 4 Bystanders. Malekith captures a [Villainous Weapon] from the city or from any player's control or discard pile. The this Tactic enters the city as a [Villainous Weapon].
 | 
[Artifact] - Once per turn, draw a card.

cards.name: Vulnerable to Cold Iron
cards.abilities: Fight: You get +2[Recruit] for each [Tech] Hero you have.

cards.name: The Beyonder
cards.abilities:
[Cosmic Threat] for cards that cost 5 or more.
Always Leads: From Beyond
Master Strike: Each player reveals a card that costs 5 or more or gains a Wound. Then put this Strike under an HQ space (that doesn't already have a Strike), pulling that space into a Pocket Dimension. To recruit a card from a Pocket Dimension, you must also pay 1[Attack] for each Pocket Dimension in play.

cards.name: Epic Beyonder
cards.abilities:
[Cosmic Threat] for cards that cost 6 or more.
Always Leads: From Beyond
Master Strike: Each player reveals a card that costs 6 or more or gains a Wound. Then put this Strike under an HQ space (that doesn't already have a Strike), pulling that space into a Pocket Dimension. To recruit a card from a Pocket Dimension, you must also pay 1[Attack] for each Pocket Dimension in play.

cards.name: Playthings of a Petulant God
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and KOs a card from their hand or discard pile with the same card name as any card in a Pocket Dimension.

cards.name: Dimensional Collapse
cards.abilities: Fight: Destroy an HQ space that's in a Pocket Dimension. (That space doesn't refill.) To mark this, turn the Hero there face down. The Pocket Dimension card stays in play.

cards.name: Pull Earth Into The Beyond
cards.abilities: Fight: Rescue four Bystanders. Put this card above the Sewers, pulling it into a Pocket Dimension. To fight a Villain there, you must also pay 1[Attack] for each Pocket Dimension in play.

cards.name: Create the Secret Wars
cards.abilities: Fight: Choose a team (e.g. [S.H.I.E.L.D.],[Avengers],[X-Men],[Guardians of the Galaxy], etc.). [Contest of Champions] for that team icon, with Evil selecting from 4 cards from the Hero Deck. Each other player that loses gains a Wound. If you win, the player of your choice gains a Hero from a Pocket Dimension.

cards.name: The Grandmaster
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Elders of the Universe
Master Strike: Reveal the top card of the Hero Deck then put it back. [Contest of Champions] for that card's color(s). Each player that loses gains a Wound. If the Grandmaster wins, he gains a [Shard].

cards.name: Epic Grandmaster
cards.abilities:
Evil adds +2 to its final total in every [Contest of Champions] caused by any card.
Always Leads: Elders of the Universe
Master Strike: Reveal the top card of the Hero Deck then put it back. [Contest of Champions] for that card's color(s). Each player that loses gains a Wound. If the Grandmaster wins, he gains 2 [Shards].

cards.name: Deal With Death
cards.abilities: Fight: [Contest of Champions] [Covert], with Evil selecting from 4 cards from the Hero Deck. Each other player that loses must KO a non-grey Hero from their discard pile. If you win, you may gain a non-grey Hero from the KO pile. If the Grandmaster wins, he gains a [Shard].

cards.name: Galactic Marathon
cards.abilities: Fight: [Contest of Champions] [Instinct], with Evil selecting from 4 cards from the Hero Deck. Each other player that loses must discard down to four cards. If you win, draw two cards. If the Grandmaster wins, he gains 2 [Shards].

cards.name: Cheat Against Thanos
cards.abilities: Fight: [Contest of Champions] [Ranged], with Evil selecting from 4 cards from the Hero Deck. Each other player that loses must KO half the Bystanders (round up) from their Victory Pile. If you win, rescue three Bystanders. If the Grandmaster Wins, he gains 3 [Shards].

cards.name: Match Offenders vs. Defenders
cards.abilities: Fight: [Contest of Champions] [Strength], with Evil selecting from 4 cards from the Hero Deck. Each other player that loses must gain a 0-cost card from the KO pile. If you win, reveal the top four cards of your deck, KO any number of them, and put the rest back in any order. If the Grandmaster wins, he gains 4 [Shards].

cards.name: Magus
cards.abilities:
Magus gets +1[Attack] for each Villain in the city that has any [Shards].
Always Leads: Universal Church of Truth
Master Strike: If there are already any Villains with [Shards] in the city, each player gains a Wound. Then this Strike enters the city as a “Cosmic Wraith“ Villain with 4[Attack] worth 4VP. Then put a [Shard] on each Villain in the city.

cards.name: Epic Magus
cards.abilities:
Magus gets +2[Attack] for each Villain in the city that has any [Shards].
Always Leads: Universal Church of Truth
Master Strike: If there are already any Villains in the city with [Shards], each player gains a Wound to the top of their deck. Then this Strike enters the city as a “Cosmic Wraith“ Villain with 6[Attack] worth 6VP. Then put a [Shard] on each Villain in the city.

cards.name: Dark Side of Adam Warlock
cards.abilities: Fight: Magus gains a [Shard]. Then Magus takes a [Shard] from each other player that does not reveal a [Covert] Hero.

cards.name: Seize Cosmic Power
cards.abilities: Fight: Magus takes a [Shard] from each Villain in the city. Then the Villain with the highest [Attack] gains a [Shard].

cards.name: Conjured Shade of Thanos
cards.abilities: Fight: Rescue 4 Bystanders. This Tactic enters the city as a Villain. Then each Villain in the city gains a [Shard]. (You win when the Mastermind has no more Tactics stacked under it.)

cards.name: Resurrected as the Child Magus
cards.abilities: Fight: Until the start of your next turn, Magus can only be fought with [Recruit] instead of [Attack].

cards.name: Iron Monger
cards.abilities:
[Bank Conqueror 4]
Always Leads: Iron Foes
Master Strike: If there is a Villain in the Bank, each player gains a Wound. Otherwise, put this Master Strike into the Bank as a 6[Attack] “StaneTech Weaponry” Villain worth 4VP.

cards.name: Hostile Takeover
cards.abilities: Fight: If there are no Villains in the bank, reveal the top card of the Villain Deck. If it’s a Villain, it enters the Bank.

cards.name: Overloaded Arsenal
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals a [Tech] Hero or gains a Wound. Then each other player reveals a [Ranged] Hero or gains a Wound.

cards.name: Sonic Stunner
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals a [Tech] Hero or discards down to 4 cards.

cards.name: Unexpected Betrayal
cards.abilities: Fight: If the Bank is empty, the player on your right chooses a Villain from their Victory Pile. That Villain enters the Bank.

cards.name: Loki
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Enemies of Asgard
Master Strike: Each player reveals a [Strength] Hero or gains a Wound.

cards.name: Cruel Ruler
cards.abilities: Fight: Defeat a Villain in the City for free.

cards.name: Maniacal Tyrant
cards.abilities: Fight: KO up to four cards from your discard pile.

cards.name: Vanishing Illusions
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player KOs a Villain from their Victory Pile.

cards.name: Whispers and Lies
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player KOs two Bystanders from their Victory Pile.

cards.name: Red Skull
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: HYDRA
Master Strike: Each player KOs a Hero from their hand.

cards.name: Endless Resources
cards.abilities: Fight: You get +4[Recruit].

cards.name: HYDRA Conspiracy
cards.abilities: Fight: Draw two cards. Then draw another card for each HYDRA Villain in your Victory Pile.

cards.name: Negablast Grenades
cards.abilities: Fight: You get +3[Attack].

cards.name: Ruthless Dictator
cards.abilities: Fight: Look at the top three cards of your deck. KO one, discard one and put one back on top of your deck.

cards.name: Lady Deathstrike
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Reavers
Master Strike: If she is [Preying] on a player, [Finish the Prey]. Otherwise, [Prey] on the fewest [Instinct].
[Finish the Prey]: That player gains two Wounds. Each other player discards two cards. (1-player game: Instead, gain a Wound and discard a card.)

cards.name: Epic Lady Deathstrike
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Reavers
Master Strike: If she is [Preying] on a player, [Finish the Prey]. Then, whether she was preying or not, [Prey] on the fewest [Instinct].
[Finish the Prey]: That player gains Wounds to the top and bottom of their deck. Each other player discards down to three cards. (1-player game: Instead, gain a Wound and discard two cards.)

cards.name: Cybernetic Healing Factor
cards.abilities: Fight: If this is not the final Tactic, and if Lady Deathstrike was not [Preying] on a player: KO up to two of your Heroes, rescue 4 Bystanders, and shuffle this Tactic back into her remaining Tactics.

cards.name: Prey on the Weak
cards.abilities: Fight: Each Villain that's [Preying] on a player [Finishes the Prey]. After those have all entered the city, then each Villain in the city with a “[Prey]“ Ambush does that Ambush, starting from the Sewers.

cards.name: Relentless Assassin
cards.abilities: Fight: If Lady Deathstrike was not [Preying] on a player, each other player reveals their hand. She [Preys] on the one of those players with the fewest non-grey Heroes.

cards.name: Stretching Adamantium Claws
cards.abilities: Fight: You may KO one of your Heroes. If you have a [Instinct] Hero, you may instead KO up to two of your Heroes.

masterminds.name: Bastion, Fused Sentinel
masterminds.alwaysLeads: Purifiers and any Sentinel Henchmen Group.

cards.name: Bastion, Fused Sentinel
cards.abilities:
All Sentinel Masterminds get +1[Attack] for each Master Strike in the KO pile, even after Bastion is defeated.
Always Leads: Purifiers and any Sentinel Henchmen Group.
Master Strike: A card from the Bystander Stack ascends to become a 3[Attack] [“Prime Sentinel“ Mastermind] with “Fight: Rescue this. Master Strike: Each player reveals the top card of their deck and discards it if it costs 1 or more.“

cards.name: Epic Bastion, Fused Sentinel
cards.abilities:
All Sentinel enemies get +1[Attack] for each Master Strike in the KO pile, even after Bastion is defeated.
Always Leads: Purifiers and any Sentinel Henchmen Group.
Master Strike: A card from the Bystander Stack ascends to become a 4[Attack] [“Prime Sentinel“ Mastermind] with “Fight: Rescue this. Master Strike: Each player reveals the top card of their deck and KOs it if it costs 1 or more.“

cards.name: Master Mold, Sentinel Factory
cards.abilities:
Fight: Rescue three Bystanders. KO one of your Heroes. Master Mold ascends to become an [additional Mastermind] whose only ability is:
 | 
Master Strike: A Sentinel Henchmen from the Villain Deck enters the city. Shuffle the Villain Deck.

cards.name: Template, Infected Sentinel
cards.abilities:
Fight: Rescue three Bystanders. KO one of your Heroes. Template ascends to become an [additional Mastermind] whose only ability is:
 | 
Master Strike: Each player reveals a [Covert] Hero or discards one of their non-grey Heroes.

cards.name: Nimrod, Future Sentinel
cards.abilities:
Fight: Rescue three Bystanders. KO one of your Heroes. Nimrod ascends to become an [additional Mastermind] whose only abilities are:
 | 
Master Strike: Choose [Recruit] or [Attack]. Each player discards a card with the chosen icon.

cards.name: Machine Man, Sentinel Supereme
cards.abilities:
Fight: Rescue three Bystanders. KO one of your Heroes. Machine Man ascends to become an [additional Mastermind] whose only ability is:
 | 
Master Strike: Each player reveals a [Tech] Hero or gains a Wound.

cards.name: Exodus
cards.abilities:
You may pay 3[Recruit] any number of times to [Shatter] Exodus.
Always Leads: Acolytes
Master Strike: Choose [X-Men], [X-Force], [X-Factor Investigations], or [Brotherhood]. Each player discards one of those Heroes or gains a Wound.

cards.name: Epic Exodus
cards.abilities:
Any number of times, you may [Shatter] Exodus by spending  2[Recruit] plus 1[Recruit] for each Immortality stacked here.
Always Leads: Acolytes
Master Strike: Stack this Strike next to Exodus as an “Immortality.“ Choose [X-Men], [X-Force], [X-Factor Investigations], or [Brotherhood]. Each player KOs one of those Heroes or gains a Wound to the top of their deck.

cards.name: Unite All Mutantkind
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player chooses one of their [X-Men], [X-Force], [X-Factor Investigations], or [Brotherhood] Heroes to enter the city as a Villain with [Attack] equal to its cost and “Fight: Gain this as a Hero.“ If no card enters the city this way, then each player gains a Wound.

cards.name: Omega-Level Mutant
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals their hand, discards all their cards that cost 1 or more, then draws that many cards.

cards.name: Avalon, Asteroid Haven
cards.abilities: Fight: You may gain a [X-Men], [X-Force], [X-Factor Investigations], or [Brotherhood] Hero from the HQ. Each other player discards two cards that aren't any of those teams.

cards.name: Resurrect the Dead
cards.abilities: Fight: Choose a player. That player gains a [X-Men], [X-Force], [X-Factor Investigations], or [Brotherhood] Hero from the KO pile, then chooses a Non-Henchmen Villain from their Victory Pile to enter the city.

cards.name: Lilith, Mother of Demons
cards.abilities:
Lilith gets +1[Attack] for each Bystander in the KO pile.
Always Leads: Lilin
Master Strike: Lilith [Hunts for Victims]. If she KOs a Bystander this way, each player gains a Wound.

cards.name: Epic Lilith
cards.abilities:
Lilith gets +2[Attack] for each Bystander in the KO pile.
Always Leads: Lilin
Master Strike: Lilith [Hunts for Victims]. If she KOs a Bystander this way, each player gains a Wound to the top of their deck.

cards.name: Connoisseur of Souls
cards.abilities:
Fight: You get +1[Recruit] for each Bystander in the KO pile.
Then Lilith [Hunts for Victims].

cards.name: Offer of Corruption
cards.abilities:
Fight: Choose one:
- Gain a Wound and each other player KOs one of their Heroes, or
- KO one of your Heroes and each other player gains a Wound.
Then Lilith [Hunts for Victims].

cards.name: Mesopotamian Demon Goddess
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player may discard a card for each Bystander in the KO pile. Each of those players who didn't must gain a Wound instead.
Then Lilith [Hunts for Victims].

cards.name: Respawn Demonic Offspring
cards.abilities:
Fight: The highest VP Lilin Villain from among all Victory Piles reenters the city. The player who had that Villain rescues three Bystanders.
Then Lilith [Hunts for Victims].
(Don't do any Escape or Ambush effects until after you've done all the other affects on this card.)

cards.name: Zarathos
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: The Fallen
Master Strike: If any Heroes in the HQ are haunted, each player gains a Wound. Then if Zarathos is not already haunting, he [Haunts] the highest-cost unhaunted Hero in the HQ.

cards.name: Epic Zarathos
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: The Fallen
Master Strike: If any Heroes in the HQ are haunted, each player gains a Wound. Then if Zarathos is not already haunting, he [Haunts] the highest-cost unhaunted Hero in the HQ. Then reveal the top card of the Villain Deck. If it's a Villain, it Haunts the highest cost unhaunted Hero in the HQ.

cards.name: Eruption of Hellfire
cards.abilities:
Fight: Zarathos [Haunts] the highest-cost unhaunted [Covert] and/or [Ranged] Hero in the HQ.
Each other player discards a [Covert] or [Ranged] Hero or gains a Wound.

cards.name: Corrupted Spirit of Vengeance
cards.abilities:
Fight: Zarathos [Haunts] the highest-cost unhaunted [Instinct] and/or [Covert] Hero in the HQ.
Each other player discards a [Instinct] or [Covert] Hero or discards down to 3 cards.

cards.abilities:
Fight: Zarathos [Haunts] the highest-cost unhaunted [Strength] and/or [Instinct] Hero in the HQ.
If you have a [Strength] or [Instinct] Hero, you may KO a Villain from your Victory Pile. If you do, draw cards equal to that Villain's VP.

cards.name: Demonic Essence of Ghost Rider
cards.abilities:
Fight: Zarathos [Haunts] the highest-cost unhaunted [Ranged] and/or [Strength] Hero in the HQ.
If you have a [Ranged] Hero, you may KO one of your Heroes.
If you have a [Strength] Hero, you may KO one of your Heroes.

cards.name: Darren Cross
cards.abilities:
[Bank Conqueror 6]

cards.name: Yellowjacket

[Microscopic Size-Changing] [Tech][Tech]
Master Strike: Each player discards a [Instinct] Hero or [Size-Changing] Hero or gains a Wound. Yellowjacket [Transforms].

cards.name: Corporate Raider
cards.abilities:
Fight: KO one of your Heroes with a [Recruit] icon. If the Bank is empty, move a Villain to the Bank.
This Mastermind [Transforms].

cards.name: Protect My Investments
cards.abilities:
Fight: If the Bank is empty, each other player chooses a Villain worth 2[Victory Points] or more from their Victory Pile. You choose one of those Villains to enter the Bank.
This Mastermind [Transforms].

cards.name: Shrinking Research Budget
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each Hero currently in the HQ that has no [Size-Changing] abilities gains [Size-Changing] for one of its Hero Classes.
This Mastermind [Transforms].

cards.name: Steal Pym Particles
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player shuffles a [Covert], [Tech], or [Size-Changing] card from their hand or discard pile into the Hero Deck.
This Mastermind [Transforms].

cards.name: Ghost, Master Thief
cards.abilities:
Ghost gets +1[Attack] for each different cost among her “Kidnapped Victimis.“ While this side is face up, you may recruit cards from her Kidnapped Victims (in any order), spending 2[Recruit] extra for each.

Master Strike: Each player reveals a [Instinct] Hero or discards two cards with [Recruit] icons. Ghost [Transforms].

cards.name: Ghost, Intangible
cards.abilities:
You can't fight Ghost unless you made at least 6[Recruit] this turn.
Master Strike: Each player discards a [Covert] Hero or puts a non-grey Hero from their hand or discard pile next to Ghost as a “Kidnapped Victim.“ Ghost [Transforms].

cards.name: Elaborate Rescue Plan
cards.abilities:
Fight: You may choose a player to gain one of Ghost's Kidnapped Victims.
Ghost [Transforms].

cards.name: Nightmarish Wraith
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player puts a non-grey Hero from their discard pile next to Ghost as a Kidnapped Victim.
Ghost [Transforms].

cards.name: Shadowy Abduction
cards.abilities:
Fight: Put the highest cost Hero from the HQ next to Ghost as a Kidnapped Victim.
Ghost [Transforms].

cards.name: Draining Quantum Energy Chamber
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and KOs one of their cards that shares a Hero Class with any of Ghost's Kidnapped Victims.
Ghost [Transforms].

masterminds.name: Kang, Quantum Conqueror
masterminds.alwaysLeads: Armada of Kang. Set aside the Villains from an extra Villain Group as “Timeline Variants.“

cards.name: Kang, Quantum Conqueror
cards.abilities:
[Rooftops Conqueror 3, Streets Conqueror 3, Bridge Conqueror 3]
Always Leads: Armada of Kang. Set aside the Villains from an extra Villain Group as “Timeline Variants.“
Master Strike: Each player discards a [Strength] Hero or gains a Wound. Put a random Timeline Variant Villain face up in the “Multiverse“ space. Kang [Transforms].

cards.name: Kang, Multiverse Conqueror
cards.abilities:
[Multiverse Conqueror 8]
While either side of Kang is face up, the “Multiverse“ is a space to his left that can hold multiple Villains. You can fight them (in any order) only while this side is face up.
Master Strike: If there are any Villains in the Multiverse, each player gains a Wound. Then a Villain from the Multiverse enters an empty space among the Rooftops, Streets or Bridge. Kang [Transforms].

cards.abilities:
Fight: If there are any Villains in the Rooftops, Streets, and/or Bridge, each player gains a Wound. If there are any Villains in the Multiverse, each player gains a Wound.
Kang [Transforms].

cards.name: Kang's Defiance
cards.abilities:
Fight: If any of the Rooftops, Streets, or Bridge are empty, reveal the top card of the Villain Deck. If it's a Villain, it enters one of those spaces.
Put a random Timeline Variant Villain face up in the “Multiverse“ space.
Kang [Transforms].

cards.name: Multiversal Engine Core
cards.abilities:
Fight: Kang [Double-Crosses] each other player.
Put a random Timeline Variant Villain face up in the “Multiverse“ space.
Kang [Transforms].

cards.name: The Time Sphere
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player puts two cards from their hand on the bottom of their deck. You draw two cards.
Kang [Transforms].

cards.name: Ronan the Accuser
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Followers of Ronan
Master Strike: Each player discards a card at random. Ronan captures this Strike as a “Necrocraft Ship“ [Villainous Weapon] that gives +1[Attack]. When you gain a Necrocraft Ship, it becomes a [Triggered Artifact] that says “Whenever a Master Strike is completed, draw a card.“

cards.name: Epic Ronan the Accuser
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Followers of Ronan
Master Strike: Each player with six or more cards in hand discards two cards at random. Ronan captures this Strike as a “Necrocraft Ship“ [Villainous Weapon] that gives +2[Attack]. When you gain a Necrocraft Ship, it becomes a [Triggered Artifact] that says “Whenever a Master Strike is completed, draw a card.“

cards.abilities:
Fight: KO one of your Heroes. Rescue 2 Bystanders. Ronan captures this card as a [Villainous Weapon].
 |

cards.abilities:
Fight: KO one of your Heroes. Rescue 2 Bystanders. Ronan captures this card as a [Villainous Weapon].

cards.name: Ancient Kree Armor

masterminds.name: Ego, the Living Planet

cards.name: Epic Thanos

[Endgame]: Then each other player reveals a [Ranged] Hero or gains a Wound.

Always Leads: Any Villain Group

cards.abilities: Fight: You may gain a Hero from the HQ that costs 2 or less.

cards.name: Epic Zombie Scarlet Witch

cards.abilities:

cards.name: Even the Odds

cards.name: Refuse to Accept Death

You may gain a Hero from the KO pile.

cards.name: Wistful Illusion
cards.abilities:
Fight: Before putting this Tactic in your Victory Pile, [Rise of The Living Dead]. (This ability never makes Mastermind Tactics return.)
Reveal the top card of the Hero Deck then put it on the bottom of the Hero Deck. You may play a copy of that card this turn.

cards.name: Killmonger, The Betrayer

Always Leads: Vibranium Liberator Drones

cards.name: Epic Killmonger, The Betrayer

cards.name: Pulling the Strings
cards.abilities: Fight: You get +1[Recruit] for each different Villain Group in your Victory Pile.

cards.name: See You on the Flip Side

Ultron Wins: When he has gained five Infinity Stones.

cards.name: Struggle for the Infinity Stones
cards.abilities: Fight: Gain a Hero from the HQ that has one of the Hero Classes that is [Empowering] Ultron.

cards.name: Transcend Mortality
cards.abilities: Fight: Search the Villain Deck and stack the first Ultron Sentry you find next to Ultron. Shuffle the Villain Deck.

cards.name: Unfettered Annihilation
cards.abilities: Fight: For each Ultron Sentry in your Victory Pile, you may KO a Hero from your hand or discard pile.

cards.name: Epic Belasco

Belasco gets +[Attack] equal to the number of non-grey Heroes in the KO pile, divided by the number of players (round down).

cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player KOs a non-grey Hero from their hand or discard pile.

cards.name: Cleaving Demonblade
cards.abilities: Fight: Each player chooses a different card in the HQ. Then KO all chosen cards.

cards.abilities:
During your turn, Emma Frost gets +1[Attack] for each grey Hero you have.
Always Leads: Hellions

cards.name: Epic Emma Frost
cards.abilities:

Always Leads: Hellions

cards.abilities: Fight: You may play the top card of the Villain Deck. If you do, you get +5[Recruit].

cards.name: Psychic X-Men Link
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player has a [Waking Nightmare]. Each of those players who did not discard an [X-Men] Hero this way gains a Wound.

cards.name: Assume Diamond Form
cards.abilities: Fight: Emma Frost cannot be fought again until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Contempt for Weaklings
cards.abilities: Fight: Put a 0-cost Hero from the KO pile on top of each other player's deck.

cards.name: X-Con Men
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals an [X-Men] Hero or gains a Wound.

cards.name: The Goblin, Underworld Boss
cards.abilities:

Always Leads: Goblin's Freak Show
Master Strike: Two random Bystanders from each player's Victory Pile become [Hidden Witness] held by The Goblin. Any player who didn't have two Bystanders gains a Wound instead.

cards.name: Sinister Dreams
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals a [Sinister Six] or [Spider Friends] Hero or gains a Wound.

cards.abilities:
[Feast]

cards.name: Feed Me
cards.abilities:
[Feast]

[Feast]

cards.abilities: Fight: You get +1[Recruit] for each Mastermind Tactic Mysterio has left after this one.

cards.abilities: Fight: Rescue a Bystander for each Mastermind Tactic Mysterio has left after this one.

cards.name: Anoint an Heir to Take My Place
cards.abilities:
Fight: If this is not the last Tactic, a Hero from the HQ that costs 6 or more Ascends to become an additional Mastermind with [Attack] equal to its printed cost and only these abilities: “Fight: Choose a player to gain this as a Hero.
Master Strike: Each player discards a card of this Hero Class or gains a Wound.“

cards.name: Bite of the Muramasa Blade
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals three cards with different, adjacent costs (e.g. 2,3,4) or gains a Wound.

cards.name: Master of Schemes
cards.abilities: Fight: If this is not the last Tactic, reveal the top 2 cards of the Villain Deck. Play a Master Strike or Scheme Twist from among them, putting the rest back in any order.

cards.name: Take Over the Weapon X Program
cards.abilities: Fight: You get +[Recruit] equal to the [Attack] Romulus is gaining from [Weapon X Sequence].

cards.name: Sabretooth
cards.abilities:
Sabretooth [Berserks] once for each Savagery stacked here.
Always Leads: Berserkers
Master Strike: Stack this Strike next to Sabretooth as a “Savagery.“ Each player KOs one of their Heroes that costs more than the number of Savageries. Any player that cannot do so gains a Wound instead.
[Fail]: KO a non-grey Hero discarded by Sabretooth's Berserking.

cards.name: Epic Sabretooth
cards.abilities:
Sabretooth [Berserks] once for each Savagery stacked here, plus two more times.
Always Leads: Berserkers
Master Strike: Stack this Strike next to Sabretooth as a “Savagery.“ Each player KOs one of their Heroes that costs at least 2 more than the number of Savageries. Any player that cannot do so gains a Wound instead.
[Fail]: KO a non-grey Hero discarded by Sabretooth's Berserking.

cards.name: Adamantium-Laced Claws
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals a [Instinct] Hero or gains a Wound.

cards.name: Lethal Fangs
cards.abilities: Fight: KO a grey Hero discarded by Sabretooth's Berserking. (You can't KO cards you shuffled into your deck during the Berserking.)

cards.name: Salivating Prowl
cards.abilities: Fight: Reveal the top three cards of your deck. Draw one of them, discard one, and put the other back on top of your deck.

cards.name: Sudden Savagery
cards.abilities: Fight: Stack a card from the Wound Deck next to Sabretooth as a “Savagery.“

cards.name: General “Thunderbolt” Ross
cards.abilities:
Start of Game: Stack 8 Bystanders next to General Ross as “Helicopter“ Villains with 2[Attack]. You can fight them to rescue them as Bystanders. You can't fight General Ross while he has any Helicopters.
Always Leads: Code Red
Master Strike: General Ross [Transforms], then [Cross-Dimensional Hulk Rampage].

cards.name: Red Hulk
cards.abilities:
[Wounded Fury]
You can't fight Helicopters, and they don't stop you from fighting Red Hulk.
Master Strike: Red Hulk [Transforms], then stack a random Bystander from each player's Victory Pile next to this as a Helicopter. Each player who didn't have a Bystander gains a Wound instead.

cards.name: Bust You Down to Private
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player puts a non-grey Hero from their hand on the bottom of the Hero Deck, then puts a 0-cost Hero from the KO pile into their hand.
This Mastermind [Transforms].

cards.name: Call Out the Army
cards.abilities:
Fight: Put 3 Bystanders from the Bystander Stack next to this Mastermind as “Helicopters.“
This Mastermind [Transforms].

cards.name: Personal Arsenal
cards.abilities:
Fight: For each Master Strike in the KO pile, put a Bystander from the Bystander Stack next to the Mastermind as a “Helicopter.“
This Mastermind [Transforms].

cards.name: Urban Warfare
cards.abilities:
Fight: Put a random Bystander next to the Mastermind as a “Helicopter“ from each of these places: The Bystander Stack, the Escape Pile, each city space, and each other player's Victory Pile.
This Mastermind [Transforms].

cards.name: Illuminati, Secret Society
cards.abilities:
This Mastermind gets +4[Attack] unless you [Outwit] them.
Always Leads: Illuminati
Master Strike: Each player reveals their hand and discards two cards that each cost between 1 and 4. The Illuminati [Transform].

cards.name: Illuminati, Open Warfare
cards.abilities:
Whenever a card effect causes a player to draw any number of cards, that player must then also discard a card.
Master Strike: Each player reveals their hand and discards two cards that each cost between 5 and 8. The Illuminati [Transform].

cards.name: Black Bolt's Omni-Shout
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and discards two cards with no rules text.
The Illuminati [Transform].

cards.name: Dr. Strange's Orb of Agamotto
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and discards a [Ranged] or [Instinct] Hero.
The Illuminati [Transform].

cards.name: Hulkbuster's Hammer Fist
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and KOs a [Tech] or [Strength] Hero from their hand or discard pile.
The Illuminati [Transform].

cards.name: Zom's Manacles of Living Bondage
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player reveals a [Covert] Hero or gains a Wound.
The Illuminati [Transform].

cards.name: King Hulk, Sakaarson
cards.abilities:
King Hulk gets +1[Attack] for each Warbound Villain in the city and in the Escape Pile.
Always Leads: Warbound
Master Strike: Each player KO's a Warbound Villain from their Victory Pile or gains a Wound. King Hulk [Transforms].

cards.name: King Hulk, Worldbreaker
cards.abilities:
[Wounded Fury]
Master Strike: Each player reveals their hand, then KO's a card from their hand or discard pile that has the same card name as a card in the HQ. King Hulk [Transforms].

cards.name: Fury of the Green Scar
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and discards a Hero that isn't grey and isn't [Strength].
King Hulk [Transforms].

cards.name: Oath of the Warbound
cards.abilities:
Fight: The Villain in the Escape Pile with the highest printed [Attack] enters the Sewers.
King Hulk [Transforms].

cards.name: Revenge from the Stars
cards.abilities:
Fight: After you put this in your Victory Pile, [Cross-Dimensional Hulk Rampage].
King Hulk [Transforms].

cards.name: Rule By the Strongest
cards.abilities:
Fight: You get +1[Recruit] for each of your [Strength] Heroes.
King Hulk [Transforms].

cards.name: M.O.D.O.K.
cards.abilities:
All cards' [Outwit] abilities require four different costs instead of three.
Always Leads: Intelligencia
Master Strike: Each player who can't [Outwit] M.O.D.O.K. gains a Wound, then M.O.D.O.K. [Transforms].

cards.name: M.O.D.O.K., Network Nightmare
cards.abilities:
You can only fight M.O.D.O.K. with [Recruit], not [Attack].
Master Strike: Each player who can't [Outwit] M.O.D.O.K. KO's a non-grey Hero from their discard pile. M.O.D.O.K. [Transforms].

cards.name: Brain Scramble
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player discards their hand, then draws as many cards as they discarded.
M.O.D.O.K. [Transforms].

cards.name: Designed Only For...K.O.ING
cards.abilities:
Fight: Reveal the top three cards of your deck. KO one of them, draw one, and discard one.
M.O.D.O.K. [Transforms].

cards.name: Don't Get a Big head About It
cards.abilities:
Fight: Draw a card for each Intelligencia Villain in your Victory Pile.
M.O.D.O.K. [Transforms].

cards.name: Redundancy Algorithim
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and discards two cards that hand the same cost.
M.O.D.O.K. [Transforms].

cards.name: The Red King
cards.abilities:
You can't fight the Red King while any Villains are in the city.
Always Leads: Sakaar Imperial Guard
Master Strike: The Red King [Transforms], then each player reveals a [Tech] card or gains a Wound.

cards.name: The Red King, Power Armored
cards.abilities: Master Strike: The Red King [Transforms], then play another card from the Villain Deck.

cards.name: Haughty Spite
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player without a Red King Tactic in their Victory Pile gains a Wound.
The Red King [Transforms].

cards.name: Royal Bodyguard
cards.abilities:
Fight: Reveal cards from the Villain Deck until you reveal a Sakaar Imperial Guard. If you find one, play it. Either way, shuffle all the other revealed cards back into the Villain Deck.
The Red King [Transforms].

cards.name: Treasury of Sakaar
cards.abilities:
Fight: You get +1[Recruit] for each Sakaar Imperial Guard and Red King Tactic in your Victory Pile, including this one.
The Red King [Transforms].

cards.name: Vast Armies of Sakaar
cards.abilities:
Fight: If this is not the final Tactic, reveal the top three cards of the Villain Deck. Play all the Villains you revealed. Put the rest back in random order.
The Red King [Transforms].

cards.name: The Sentry
cards.abilities:
Start of Game: Shuffle 2 Wounds into each player's deck before drawing starting hands.
Always Leads: Aspects of the Void
Master Strike: The Sentry [Transforms], then [Cross-Dimensional Void Rampage].

cards.name: The Void
cards.abilities:
[Wounded Fury]
Master Strike: [Feast] on each player. If this feasts on a player's grey Hero, that player gains a Wound. The Void [Transforms].

cards.name: Pacifying Light
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and discard two cards with [Recruit] icons.
This Mastermind [Transforms].

cards.name: Power of a Million Exploding Suns
cards.abilities:
Fight: Put all Heroes from the HQ on the bottom of the Hero Deck. Each other player reveals their hand and discards each card with the same card name as any of those cards.
This Mastermind [Transforms].

cards.name: Reflexive Teleportation
cards.abilities:
Fight: Choose one of your Heroes that costs 5 or less. When you draw a new hand of cards at the end of this turn, add that Hero to your hand as an extra card.
This Mastermind [Transforms].

cards.name: Repressed Darkness
cards.abilities:
Fight: Each other player reveals a [Ranged] Hero or plays an Aspects of the Void Villain from their Victory Pile as if playing it from the Villain Deck.
This Mastermind [Transforms].

cards.name: Arcade
cards.abilities:
Start of Game: Arcade captures 5 [Human Shields].
Always Leads: Murderworld
Master Strike: Arcade captures a random Bystander from each player's Victory Pile as a [Human Shield]. Each player who didn't have a Bystander gains a Wound instead.

cards.name: Epic Arcade
cards.abilities:
Start of Game: Arcade captures 8 [Human Shields]. Play a random Horror.
Always Leads: Murderworld
Master Strike: Arcade captures two random Bystander from each player's Victory Pile as a [Human Shield]. Each player who didn't have two Bystanders gains a Wound instead.

cards.name: I Love a Parade!
cards.abilities: Fight: Arcade captures two [Human Shields]. Play an extra card from the Villain Deck next turn.

cards.name: I Need an Audience
cards.abilities: Fight: Arcade captures [Human Shields] equal to the number of Villains in the city.

cards.name: Roulette Wheel of Death
cards.abilities: Fight: Arcade captures a random Bystander as a [Human Shield] from each of these places: The Bystander Stack, the Escape Pile, each city space, and each other player's Victory Pile.

cards.name: Welcome to my Theme Park!
cards.abilities: Fight: Arcade and each Murderworld Villain in the city capture two [Human Shields].

cards.name: Dark Phoenix
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Hellfire Club
Master Strike: KO the top card of the Hero Deck and each card in the Hero Deck that shares a color with it. Shuffle the Hero Deck.
Dark Phoenix Wins: When the Hero Deck is empty.

cards.name: Epic Dark Phoenix
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Hellfire Club
Master Strike: KO the top card of the Hero Deck and each card in the Hero Deck that shares a color with it. Shuffle the Hero Deck. Then, each player plays a Hellfire Club card from their Victory Pile. Next, play a random Horror.
Dark Phoenix Wins: When the Hero Deck is empty.

cards.name: Burn the World to Ashes
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player discards each card from their hand that has the same name as any card in the KO pile.

cards.name: Consume an Entire Galaxy
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player chooses a card from their discard pile that costs 1 or more and KOs it.

cards.name: Fiery Reincarnation
cards.abilities: Fight: Gain a Hero from the KO pile that costs 7 or more.

cards.name: Worship Me as a God
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player gains two 0-cost cards from the KO pile.

masterminds.name: Deathbird
masterminds.alwaysLeads: Shi'ar Imperial Guard and a Shi'ar Henchmen Group.

cards.name: Deathbird
cards.abilities:
Deathbird gets +1[Attack] for each Shi'ar Villain in the city and Escape Pile.
Always Leads: Shi'ar Imperial Guard and a Shi'ar Henchmen Group.
Master Strike: If there are already any Shi'ar Villains in the city, each player gains a Wound. Then this strike enters the city as a “Shi'ar Battlecruiser“ [Token Card] Villain with 7[Attack] worth 5 [Victory Points].

cards.name: Epic Deathbird
cards.abilities:
Deathbird gets +2[Attack] for each Shi'ar Villain in the city and Escape Pile.
Always Leads: Shi'ar Imperial Guard and a Shi'ar Henchmen Group.
Master Strike: If there are already any Shi'ar Villains in the city, play a random Horror. Then this strike enters the city as a “Shi'ar Battleship“ [Token Card] Villain with 9[Attack] worth 6 [Victory Points].

cards.name: Shi'ar Elite Bodyguards
cards.abilities: Fight: Rescue 4 Bystanders. This Tactic enters the city as a Villain whose only ability is “Escape: Shuffle this card back into Deathbird's Mastermind Tactics as another Tactic.“

cards.name: Shi'ar Extermination Legion
cards.abilities: Fight: Rescue 4 Bystanders. This Tactic enters the city as a Villain whose only ability is “Escape: Each player discards two cards.“

cards.name: Shi'ar Hovertake Battalion
cards.abilities: Fight: Rescue 4 Bystanders. This Tactic enters the city as a Villain whose only ability is “Escape: Each player gains a Wound.“

cards.name: Shi'ar Master Spies
cards.abilities: Fight: Rescue 4 Bystanders. This Tactic enters the city as a Villain whose only ability is “Escape: This card becomes a Scheme Twist that takes effect immediately.“

cards.name: Mojo
cards.abilities:
Start of Game: Mojo captures 3 [Human Shields].
All Bystanders in Victory Piles are worth 3 [Victory Points].
Always Leads: Mojoverse
Master Strike: Mojo captures a [Human Shield]. Each player reveals a [Tech] Hero or discards a card at random.

cards.name: Epic Mojo
cards.abilities:
Start of Game: Mojo captures 6 [Human Shields]. Play a random Horror.
All Bystanders in Victory Piles are worth 4 [Victory Points].
Always Leads: Mojoverse
Master Strike: Mojo and each Mojoverse Villain capture a [Human Shield]. Each player reveals a [Tech] Hero or discards down to 4 cards.

cards.name: Billions of TV Viewers
cards.abilities: Fight: Each player reveals a [Tech] Hero or chooses a random Bystander from their Victory Pile. Mojo captures those Bystanders as [Human Shields].

cards.name: Brain-Melting TV Marathon
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player without a Mojo Tactic in their Victory Pile gains a Wound.

cards.name: Cross-Dimensional Marketing
cards.abilities: Fight: You get +1[Recruit] for each Bystander in your Victory Pile. Mojo captures a [Human Shield].

cards.name: Mojo Branding Opportunity
cards.abilities: Fight: Draw a card for each Mojoverse Villain in your Victory Pile. Mojo captures a [Human Shield].

cards.name: Onslaught
cards.abilities:
Each player's hand size is 1 less.
Always Leads: Dark Descendants
Master Strike: KO all Heroes [Dominated] by Onslaught. Then each player reveals their hand and chooses one of their non-grey Heroes. Onslaught [Dominates] those Heroes.

cards.name: Epic Onslaught
cards.abilities:
Each player's hand size is 1 less.
Always Leads: Dark Descendants
Master Strike: KO all Heroes [Dominated] by Onslaught. Then each player reveals their hand and chooses two of their non-grey Heroes. Onslaught [Dominates] those Heroes. Then play a random Horror.

cards.name: Godlike Psionic Entity
cards.abilities: Fight: Onslaught [Dominates] all five Heroes from the HQ.

cards.name: Sins of X-Men Past
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals the top six cards of their deck and chooses an [X-Men] Hero revealed this way. Onslaught [Dominates] those Heroes. Put the rest back in random order.

cards.name: Xavier and Magneto Combined
cards.abilities: Fight: Reveal the top three cards of the Hero Deck. Onslaught [Dominates] all the [X-Men] and [Brotherhood] Heroes you revealed. Put the rest back in random order.

cards.name: Worldwide Mental Control
cards.abilities: Fight: Onslaught [Dominates] four 0-cost Heroes from the KO pile. The next time a player fights Onslaught, KO those 0-cost Heroes.

cards.name: Shadow King
cards.abilities:
Always Leads: Shadow-X
Master Strike: KO all Heroes [Dominated] by Shadow King. Then each player chooses a non-grey Hero from their discard pile. Shadow King [Dominates] those Heroes.

cards.name: Epic Shadow King
cards.abilities:
Start of Game: Play two random Horrors.
Always Leads: Shadow-X
Master Strike: KO all Heroes [Dominated] by Shadow King. Then each player chooses two non-grey Hero from their discard pile. Shadow King [Dominates] those Heroes.

cards.name: Fiend of the Astral Plane
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and shuffles two cards with [Recruit] icons from their hand back into their deck.

cards.name: Poison their Minds
cards.abilities: Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and chooses one of their non-grey Heroes. Shadow King [Dominates] those Heroes.

cards.name: Psychic Seduction
cards.abilities: Fight: Shadow King [Dominates] each Hero that costs 5 or less from the HQ.

cards.name: Telepathic Betrayal
cards.abilities: Fight: If the “Betrayal of the Shadow“ Trap is in any Victory Pile or the KO pile, put it on top of the Villain Deck.

cards.name: Pull Reality Into Cyberspace
cards.abilities:
Setup: 7 Twists, representing “Cyberspace.“
Special Rules: Enemies under any Cyberspace get +1[Attack] for each Cyberspace on the board, and they can be fought with any combination of [Recruit] and [Attack].
Twists 1-5: Put this Cyberspace above the rightmost city space that isn't yet under Cyberspace.
Twist 6: Put this Cyberspace above the Mastermind.
Twist 7: Evil Wins!

schemes.name: Become President of the United States

cards.name: Become President of the United States
cards.abilities:
Setup: 11 Twists
Special Rules: Once per turn, you may stack one of your non-grey Heroes next to this Scheme to earn “Ten Million Votes“ For that Hero Name. If you do, you may also send one of your grey Heroes [Undercover] as “Secret Service.“
Twist: If there's a Villain in the Bank or Streets, the Mastermind “vows to cursh crime“ and you stack this Twist next to the Mastermind as “Ten Million Votes.“ Otherwise, you may discard two cards to “counter negative advertising,“ shuffle this Twist back into the Villain Deck, and play another card from that deck. If you don't discard, stack this Twist next to the Mastermind as “Ten Million Votes.“
Evil Wins: When the Mastermind is elected President by having Forty Million more votes than the highest-voted Hero Name.

cards.name: Subjugate Earth with Mega-Corporations
cards.abilities:
Setup: Add an extra Hero. 11 Twists.
Twist: Put the Hero from the HQ space under the Bank into a “Mega-Corp Domination“ Stack matching its Hero Class (off of the board). Do the listed effect for that Mega-Corp:
[Strength]: Green Globe: Each player discards a card with a [Recruit] icon.
[Instinct]: Alchemax: Each player discards a [Instinct] Hero or gains a Wound.
[Covert]: Public Eye: Each plaeyer discards two cards, then draws a card.
[Tech]: D/MONIX: Each player discards a card with an [Attack] icon.
[Ranged]: Stark-Fujikawa: A villain from your Victory Pile reenters the city.
Evil Wins: When a single Mega-Corp has 3 Dominations.

schemes.name: Befoul Earth Into a Polluted Wasteland

cards.name: Befoul Earth Into a Polluted Wasteland
cards.abilities:
Setup: Add an extra Hero. 8 Twists, representing “Toxic Sludge.“
Twist: Put this Toxic Sludge under and HQ space. NO space can have two Sludges unless all spaces already have one.
Special Rules: To recruit a Hero, you must also pay 2 [Recruit] for each Toxic Sludge under it. During your turn, if there is any Sludge under the HQ, you may “flush the Toxic Sludge into the river.“ If you do, then KO all the Sludge and the Heroes in those HQ spaces, and each player gains a Wound.
Evil Wins: When the Hero Deck runs out, or there are 8 Toxic Sludges under the HQ and/or in the river (KO pile).

schemes.name: Pulse Waves From the Negative Zone

cards.name: Pulse Waves From the Negative Zone
cards.abilities:
Setup: 9 Twists.
Twist 1,3,5,7: “Negative Pulse“: This turn, Heroes in the HQ cost -1[Recruit] and Villains and Masterminds get -1[Attack].
Twist 2,4,6,8: “Positive Pulse“: This turn, Heroes in the HQ cost +1[Recruit] and Villains and Masterminds get +1[Attack].
Twist 9: Evil wins!

cards.name: Sneak Attack the Heroes' Homes
cards.abilities:
Setup: 6 Twists. Each player chooses a Hero to be part of the Hero Deck. Randomly select other Heroes up to the normal number of Heroes. Each player adds to their starting deck three non-rare cards with different names from the Hero they chose and three Wounds.
Twist 1-5: Each player discards a non-grey Hero or gains a Wound.
Twist 6: Evil Wins!

cards.name: Put Humanity on Trial
cards.abilities:
Setup: 11 Twists. Stack 11 Bystanders next to the Scheme face down as “Galactic Jurors.“
Special Rules: Each Twist gives you a challenge to achieve this turn. If you do it, you have convinced a Juror, and you rescue them. If you don't, put that Juror face up next to the Villain Deck, voting to condmen Humanity.
Twist 1-2: “Opening Arguments“: Discard three cards with different names.
Twist 3,5,7: “Question Witnesses“: Recruit a Hero that costs 5 or more.
Twist 4,6,8: “Introduce Evidence“: Defeat Villain(s) worth 3VP or more.
Twist 9-11: “Closing Arguments“: Defeat the Mastermind.
Evil Wins: When 6 Jurors vote to Condmen Humanity.

cards.name: Breach Parallel Dimensions
cards.abilities:
Setup: 6 Twists. Add 4 extra Bystanders to the Villain Deck. Deal the shuffled Villain Deck into several “Dimension“ decks where the first Dimension has 1 card, the next has 2 cards, then 3, 4, etc. (The final Dimension might not have enough cards to reach its full number.)
Special Rules: Each turn, you choose which Dimension you play a card from. All players have “[Focus 1][Recruit]  [Focus] Reveal the top card of any Dimension and put it back on the top or bottom of that deck.“ If a Dimension ever has no cards left, even in the middle of a card ability, it is destroyed. Mark it with a face up Wound.
Twist: Choose a Dimension and play two cards from it. (It's ok if it only has 1.)
Evil Wins: When at least half of the original Dimensions are destroyed.

overrides.specialSetup: Only 4-5 players: add an Extra Hero to the Hero deck

cards.name: Age of Ultron
cards.abilities:
Setup: 11 Twists. 4-5 Players: Add another Hero.
Twist: Put the top card of the Hero Deck next to the Scheme in an “Evolution“ Pile. Then this Twist enters the city as an “Evolved Ultron“ Villain.
Special Rules: Evolved Ultrons have 4[Attack] and are [Empowered] by each color in the Evolution pile. They're worth 6VP.
Evil Wins: When 7 Evolved Ultrons are in the city and/or Escape Pile.

cards.name: Pull Earth into Medieval Times
cards.abilities:
Setup: 9 Twists.
Twist 1-6: Until the start of your next turn, all Villains and Mastermind everywhere have [Chivalrous Duel].
Twist 7-9: Each player puts a Villain from the Victory Pile into the Escape Pile.
Evil Wins: When 3 Villains per player have escaped.

cards.name: Transform Commuters into Giant Ants
cards.abilities:
Setup: Twists equal to the number of players plus 6.
Twist: Stack this Twist next to the Scheme. Then for each Twist in that stack, put a Bystander face down next to the Mastermind as a 2[Attack] “Giant Ant“ Villain. When you fight one, rescue it as a Bystander.
Evil Wins: When ther are 10 Giant Ants next to the Mastermind.

overrides.specialSetup: All 14 Extra Hero cards go to the Villain deck

cards.name: Trap Heroes in the Microverse
cards.abilities:
Setup: 11 Twists. Add all 14 cards for and extra Hero the Villain Deck.
Special Rules: Heroes in the Villain Deck are “Micro-Sized“ Villains with [Attack] equal to their printed cost. They have [Size-Changing] for their card color and no outher abilites while in the city. When you fight one, choose any player to gain it as a Hero.
Twist: Play two cards from the Villain Deck.
Evil Wins: When 3 Villains per player have escaped or the Villain Deck runs out.

cards.name: Seize the Wakandan Throne
cards.abilities:
Setup: 6 Twists.
Twist: If the Mastermind has the [Throne's Favor], they spend it to stack this Twist next to the Scheme as a “Tribe of Wakanda Defeated.“ Otherwise: The Mastermind gains the [Throne's Favor], shuffle this Twist back into the Villain Deck, and then play a card from the Villain Deck.
Special Rules: Whenever you fight the Mastermind, you gain the [Throne's Favor].
Evil Wins: When the 5 Tribes of Wakanda have been defeated.

cards.name: Poison Lakes with Nanite Microbots
cards.abilities:
Setup: Twists equal to 5 plus the number of players. 30 Wounds in the Wound Stack.
Twist: Stack this Twist next to the Scheme as an “Infected Nanite.“ [Wound the Mastermind]. Then for each Infected Nanite, Wound a Hero in the HQ, dividing these new Wounds as evenly as possible.
Special Rules: Whenever you recruit a Hero (or it leaves the HQ), pay 1[Recruit] less for each wound on it and choose players to gain those Wounds, dividing them as evenly as possible. Whenever a Wound is KO'd from anywhere, return it to the bottom of the Wound Stack.
Evil Wins: When the Wound Stack or Villain Deck runs out.

cards.name: Plunder Wakanda's Vibranium
cards.abilities:
Setup: 10 Twists, representing “Vibranium.“
Twist: Put any Vibranium from the city into the Escape Pile. A Bystander enters the city as a 3[Attack] “Smuggler“ Villain with “Fight: Rescue this as a Bystander.“ Then the highest [Attack] Villain captures this Twist. Put the top card of the Hero Deck next to the Scheme as a “Vibranium Attunement,“ putting any previous Attunement on the bottom of the Hero Deck.
Special Rules: A Villain holding Vibranium is [Empowered] by the colors of the Vibranium Attunement. When you defeat them, put the Vibranium in your Victory Pile, worth 3VP.
Evil Wins: When 4 Vibranium are in the Escape Pile or the Villain Deck runs out.

cards.name: Provoke a Clash of Nations
cards.abilities:
Setup: 11 Twists.
Twist 1-8: Without talking, all players simultaneously vote with a Fist, Palm, or 2 Fingers. Break ties at random. Then only you discard your hand and draw six cards. You must do the voted task below by the end of this turn or stack this Twist next to the Mastermind as an “International Crisis“.
- Fist: “War“ - Defeat a non-Henchman Villain or Mastermind Tactic.
- Palm: “Diplomacy“ - Play three Heroes that share a Hero Class.
- Two Fingers: “Commerce“ - Recruit two Heroes from the HQ.
Twist 9-11: Do all three tasks this turn or add an International Crisis.
Evil Wins: At 6 International Crises.

cards.name: Corrupt the Spy Agencies
cards.abilities:
Setup: 7 Twists.
Twist 1-6: Each player sends one of their non-grey Heroes [Undercover]. Then each player may [Unleash] a Hero from [Undercover] with a lower cost than the one that player just sent [Undercover].
Twist 7: Evil Wins!

schemes.name: Train Black Widows in the Red Room

cards.name: Train Black Widows in the Red Room
cards.abilities:
Setup: 8 Twists, minus 1 Twist per player. Add 8 S.H.I.E.L.D. Officers to the Villain Deck.
Special Rules: Officers in the Villain Deck and city are “Black Widow Initiate“ Villains with 3+[Attack] and “[Dark Memories]. Fight: Gain this as an Officer (without [Dark Memories]) or send it [Undercover].“
Twist: A Black Widow Initiate enters the city from the Officer Stack. Play another card from the Villain Deck.
Evil Wins: When there 3 Villains per player in the Escape Pile or the Villain Deck runs out.

cards.name: Sniper Rifle Assassins
cards.abilities:
Setup: 11 Twists, minus 1 Twist per player.
Twist: Each player must [Dodge] with a Hero from their hand, revealing the card they drew. KO each non-grey Hero drawn this way.
Evil Wins: When there are four non-grey Heroes per player in the KO Pile.

cards.name: Frame Heroes for Murder
cards.abilities:
Setup: 7 Twists. 6 Heroes.
Twist 1-6: Stack a card from the HQ next to the scheme as “Incriminating Evidence“ that has a different cost than any card already in that stack.
Twist 7: Add any card from the HQ to the Incriminating Evidence.
Evil Wins: When there are 5 pieces of Incriminating Evidence.

cards.name: Brainwash the Military
cards.abilities:
Setup: 7 Twists. Add 12 S.H.I.E.L.D. Officers to the Villain Deck.
Special Rules: S.H.I.E.L.D. Officers in the Villain Deck are Villains. Their [Attack] is 3 plus the number of Twists stacked next to this Scheme. When you defeat a S.H.I.E.L.D. Officer, gain it as a Hero.
Twist 1-6: Stack this Twists next to the Scheme as a “Traitor Battalion.“ Play another card from the Villain Deck.
Twist 7: All S.H.I.E.L.D. Officers in the city escape.
Evil Wins: When 5 S.H.I.E.L.D. Officers escape.

cards.name: Change the Outcome of WWII
cards.abilities:
Setup: 7 Twists. Add an extra Villain Group.
Twist: The Axis invades a new country. Put all Villains and Bystanders from the city on the bottom of the Villain Deck. The number of city spaces changes. Play 2 cards from the Villain Deck. If any Villains escape this country, stack a Twist next to the scheme as a “conquered capital.“
Twist 1: Poland: 4 spaces.
Twist 2: France: 3 spaces.
Twist 3: USSR: 6 spaces.
Twist 4: England: 3 spaces.
Twist 5: USA: 5 spaces.
Twist 6: Australia: 2 spaces.
Twist 7: Switzerland: 1 space.
Evil Wins: When 3 capitals are conquered.

schemes.name: Go Back in Time to Slay Heroes' Ancestors

cards.name: Go Back in Time to Slay Heroes' Ancestors
cards.abilities:
Setup: 9 Twists. 8 Heroes in Hero deck.
Twist: Put a Hero form the HQ next to the Scheme, “Purged from the Timestream.“
Special Rules: Whenever a Hero is in the HQ whose Hero Name has been Purged from the Timestream, KO that Hero.
Evil Wins: When the Hero Deck runs out.

cards.name: Unbreakable Enigma Code, The
cards.abilities:
Setup: 6 Twists.
Twists 1-5: Put a card from the Hero Deck face down next to the scheme as part of the “Enigma Code.“ Mix up those cards face-down.
Twist 6: Evil Wins!
Special Rules: Whenever you fight a Villain, you may pay 1[Recruit] to look at one of the face-down Enigma Cards. When you fight the Mastermind, first guess the color of each Enigma card, and then reveal them. If you guessed them right, fight the Mastermind as normal. If not, your turn ends, and mix up the Enigma cards face-down.

cards.name: Clash of the Monsters Unleashed
cards.abilities:
Setup: 10 Twists. 6 Wounds per player in the Wound Stack. Shuffle 8 Monsters Unleashed Villains into a face-down “Monster Pit“ deck.
Twist 3-10: Each player chooses a Villain from their Victory Pile as their “Gladiator.“ Then the top card of the Monster Pit enteres the city. Each player whose Gladiator has a lower printed [Attack] than that Monster gains a Wound.
Evil Wins: When the Wound Stack or Monster Pit Deck runs out.

cards.name: Divide and Conquer
cards.abilities:
Setup:  8 Twists. 7 Heroes. Sort the Hero Deck by Hero Class: [Strength],[Instinct],[Covert],[Tech],[Ranged]. (If a card has multiple Classes, break ties at random.) Put these 5 smaller, shuffled Hero Decks beneath the 5 HQ Spaces.
Special Rules: Whenever an HQ Space is empty, fill it with the top card of the Hero Deck below that space.
Twist 1-3: KO all Heroes in the HQ.
Twist 4-8: KO one of the Hero Decks.
Evil Wins: When all Hero Decks are gone.

cards.name: Hypnotize Every Human
cards.abilities:
Setup: 8 Twists. Add another Henchman Villain Group. No Bystanders in the Villain Deck.
Twist 1-6: Put a Bystander from the Bystander Stack above each city space as a facedown 2[Attack] “Hypno-Thrall“ Villain. They don't move. When you fight one, rescue it as a Bystander. You can't fight a Villain in a city space that has any Hypno-Thralls above it.
Twist 7-8: Each player puts a Villain from their Victory Pile into the Escape pile.
Evil Wins: When 8 Villains are in the Escape pile.

cards.name: Steal All Oxygen on Earth
cards.abilities:
Setup: 8 Twists. The “Oxygen Level“ starts at 8.
Twist: Stack this Twist next to the Scheme. The Oxygen Level decreases by 1. Then KO each Hero from the HQ whose cost is greater than the Oxygen Level.
Evil Wins: When 20 non-grey Heroes are KO'd.

cards.name: Avengers vs. X-Men
cards.abilities:
Setup: 9 Twists. Hero Deck has 3 Heroes of one Team and 3 Heroes of another Team. ([Avengers],[X-Men],[Spider Friends],[Marvel Knights], etc.)
Twist 1-7: Each player reveals their hand. Each player that has cards of both those teams gains a Wound.
Twist 8: Evil wins!

cards.name: Dark Reign of H.A.M.M.E.R. Officers
cards.abilities:
Setup: 7 Twists.
Twist: Stack this Twist next to the Scheme. Then, for each Twist in that stack, put a S.H.I.E.L.D. Officer next to the Mastermind as a 3[Attack] Villain with [S.H.I.E.L.D. Clearance]. You can fight them to gain them as Heroes.
Evil Wins: When there are 7 Officers next to the Mastermind.

cards.name: Epic Super Hero Civil War
cards.abilities:
Setup: 1 player: 4 Heroes in Hero Deck. 1-3 players: 9 Twists. 4-5 players: 6 Twists.
Twist: Stack this Twist next to the Scheme. Then, for each Twist in that stack, KO a Hero from the HQ and immediately refill that HQ space.
Evil Wins: When the Hero Deck runs out.

cards.name: Imprison Unregistered Superhumans
cards.abilities:
Setup: 11 Twists.
Twist 1, 3, 5, 7, 9: This Scheme [fortifies ] the city space to its right starting with the Bridge. Villains in that space get +1[Attack].
Other Twists: If there's a Villain in that fortified city space, KO a Bystander.
Evil Wins: When 3 Bystanders are in the KO pile and/or Escape Pile.

cards.name: Nitro the Supervillain Threatens Crowds
cards.abilities:
Setup: 8 Twists.
Twist: KO all Bystanders held by Villains. Then, the Villain with the highest [Attack] captures 3 Bystanders.
Evil Wins: When 15 Bystanders are in the KO pile and/or Escape Pile.

cards.name: Predict Future Crime
cards.abilities:
Setup: 6 Twists. Add an extra Villain Group.
Twist: Reveal the top 3 cards of the Villain Deck. Play each Villain you revealed. Put the rest back in any order.
Evil Wins: When there are 2 Villains per player in the Escape Pile.

cards.name: Reveal Heroes' Secret Identities
cards.abilities:
Setup: 6 Twists. 7 Heroes in Hero Deck.
Twist: Put a Hero from the HQ next to the Scheme as an “Unmasked“ Hero. All cards with “Unmasked“ Hero Names cost +1[Recruit] to recruit. You can't Unmask a Hero Name that has already been Unmasked.
Evil Wins: When 5 Heroes are Unmasked.

schemes.name: United States Split by Civil War

cards.name: United States Split by Civil War
cards.abilities:
Setup: 10 Twists.
Twist: If there is a Villain on the Streets or Bridge, put this Twist in a stack of “Western States Victories.“ Otherwise, if there is a Villain in the Sewers, put this Twist in a stack of “Eastern States Victories.“
Evil Wins: When there are 3 Western Victories or 3 Eastern Victories.

cards.name: Midtown Bank Robbery
cards.abilities:
Setup: 8 Twists. 12 total Bystanders in the Villain Deck.
Special Rules: Each Villain gets +1[Attack] for each Bystander it has.
Twist: Any Villain in the Bank captures 2 Bystanders. Then play the top card of the Villain Deck.
Evil Wins: When 8 Bystanders are carried away by escaping Villains.

schemes.name: Secret Invasion of the Skrull Shapeshifters

cards.name: Secret Invasion of the Skrull Shapeshifters
cards.abilities:
Setup: 8 Twists. 6 Heroes. Skrull Villain Group required. Shuffle 12 random Heroes from the Hero Deck into the Villain Deck.
Special Rules: Heroes in the Villain Deck count as Skrull Villains with [Attack] equal to the Hero's [Cost]+2. If you defeat that Hero, you gain it.
Twist: The highest-cost Hero from the HQ moves into the Sewers as a Skrull Villain, as above.
Evil Wins: If 6 Heroes get into the Escaped Villains pile.

cards.name: Legacy Virus, The
cards.abilities:
Setup: 8 Twists. Wound stack holds 6 Wounds per player.
Twist: Each player reveals a [Tech] Hero or gains a Wound.
Evil Wins: If the Wound stack runs out.

cards.name: Negative Zone Prison Breakout
cards.abilities:
Setup: 8 Twists. Add an extra Henchman group to the Villain Deck.
Twist: Play the top 2 cards of the Villain Deck.
Evil Wins: If 12 Villains escape.

cards.name: Portals to the Dark Dimension
cards.abilities:
Setup: 7 Twists. Each Twist is a Dark Portal.
Twist 1: Put the Dark Portal above the Mastermind. The Mastermind gets +1[Attack].
Twists 2-6: Put the Dark Portal in the leftmost city space that doesn't yet have a Dark Portal. Villains in that city space get +1[Attack].
Twist 7: Evil Wins!

cards.name: Replace Earth's Leaders with Killbots
cards.abilities:
Setup: 5 Twists. 3 additional Twists next to this Scheme. 18 total Bystanders in the Villain Deck.
Special Rules: Bystanders in the Villain Deck count as Killbot Villains, with [Attack] equal to the number of Twists next to this Scheme.
Twist: Put the Twist next to this Scheme.
Evil Wins: If 5 “Killbots“ escape.

cards.name: Super Hero Civil War
cards.abilities:
Setup: For 2-3 players, use 8 Twists. For 4-5 players, use 5 Twists. If only 2 players, use only 4 Heroes in the Hero Deck.
Twist: KO all the Heroes in the HQ.
Evil Wins: If the Hero Deck runs out.

schemes.name: Unleash the Power of the Cosmic Cube

cards.name: Unleash the Power of the Cosmic Cube
cards.abilities:
Setup: 8 Twists.
Twist: Put the Twist next to this Scheme.
Twist 5-6: Each player gains a Wound.
Twist 7: Each player gains 3 Wounds.
Twist 8: Evil Wins!

cards.name: Bank Robbery Hostage Crisis
cards.abilities:
Setup: 9 Twists. Add an extra Villain Group.
Special Rules: Each Villain gets +1[Attack] for each Bystander it has.
Twists 1-8: Any Villain in the Bank captures 2 Bystanders. If the bank is empty, move a Villain from another city space to the bank instead. Either way, play another card from the Villain Deck.
Twist 9: Put all Bystanders from the city into the Escape Pile.
Evil Wins: When 5 Bystanders are in the Escape Pile or the Villain Deck runs out.

cards.name: Enshrouded Identity
cards.abilities:
Setup: 3 Twists, plus 1 Twist per player. There is no Mastermind yet. Instead, put 3 S.H.I.E.L.D. Officers next to the Mastermind space as “Bodyguards.“
Special Rules: Bodyguards are Villains with 3[Attack] and “Fight: Either KO this card or choose a player to gain it as a Hero.“ Whenever a Master Strike occurs, if there is no Mastermind yet, add a Bodyguard instead. The first time there are no Bodyguards, add a random Mastermind to the game. (Do any “Start of Game“ effects it has.) You can't fight that Mastermind while it has any Bodyguards.
Twist: Add two Bodyguards.
Evil Wins: When there are 9 Bodyguards or the Villain Deck runs out.

cards.name: Legacy Virus, The
cards.abilities:
Setup: 9 Twists. Wound Deck holds 6 Wounds per player.
Twist: Stack this Twist next to the Scheme as a “Virus Mutation.“ Then each player reveals a Hero whose cost is greater than the number of Virus Mutations or gains a Wound.
Evil Wins: When the Wound Deck or the Villain Deck runs out.

cards.name: Negative Zone Prison Breakout
